content.short: Sentiment is a permissionless lending protocol with isolated pools and oracle-agnostic markets.
content.description: Sentiment runs lending markets where each pool is isolated and the oracle is chosen per market rather than imposed protocol-wide. That combination lets long-tail assets be listed without every depositor inheriting their risk, which is the structural fix the sector adopted after shared-pool losses in earlier cycles.
content.meta: Isolated pools with a per-market oracle, so long-tail listings do not endanger every depositor.
